name: Nagasawa Miki
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend. She is a normal girl with a bright, easy-going personality, a tomboyish girl, and a strangely girly side. 

As she gets to know the protagonist, she awakens her dormant queenly qualities.

[From [url=http://msdata.starfree.jp/msg0009/top.html]official site[/url]]
